full_judgment: Qazi Shafiuddin J: This reference being Death Reference No. 17 of 1992 has been submitted by the learned Sessions Judge, Mymensingh for confirmation of the death sentence passed upon accused Raisuddin, Samar, Amanullah, Morshed and absconding Momenuddin @ Pachu is Sessions Case No. 144 of 1991 on 13-7-92. Accused Raisuddin, Amanullah, Morshed, Samar, Mowla, Shahid, Makbul, Manik, Islam and Ramijuddin also filed an appeal being Criminal Appeal No. 1011 of 1992 against the order of conviction and sentence dated 13-7 -92 passed by the learned Sessions Judge. Accused Samar, Morshed, Raisuddin and Amanullah have also filed Jail Appeal No. 1025 of 1992 against the aforesaid order of conviction and sentence. The reference and the appeals have been heard together and will now be disposed of by this common judgment.
